summary: Frontend-only retest of GRID media upload bug fixes (A) media rendering in /grid cells and (B) media reaching /grid-output via BroadcastChannel. All requested behaviours verified via live Playwright against the preview URL.
critical_code_review_comments: GridStudio: onFiles reads whole files as base64 data URLs - fine for small clips but large videos will bloat memory and BroadcastChannel messages. Consider warning or size cap.

GridOutput: on 'scene' message, rebuild uses current mediaRef; if a 'scene' arrives before 'media' (rare race), clip.url stays undefined until the media message arrives - acceptable fallback since studio effect posts media on clips change.
grid.js assignContent guarantee only converts smallest text cell to media - if count is very low (all cells assigned to text/meta) it still fires OK; verified with count=6.
seed_data_creation: Created tiny PNGs at /tmp/test.png and /tmp/test2.png (4x4 red PNG, 70 bytes) for upload tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug A/B fully verified. Live DOM assertions on data: URLs, filter=grayscale(1)..., mixBlendMode=screen confirm duotone rendering. Cross-tab BroadcastChannel verified in both orders: upload-before-open and upload-after-open of /grid-output (same browser context). Media persists across Space beats. Remove clip clears both list and from grid-stage. Regressions (palette-red, invert/flip/wrap toggles, resize modes, play/stop, mode-kinetic nav to /) all functional. Alternated cell colors verified (2+ distinct bg colors).
